title: Trick wrong notes to test reading, and the Arban book
summary: Gaspard planted wrong notes to see if he read or played by head; Interviewer compares Bunk's Arban book; Gaspard wrote solos.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Reading music versus faking and playing by ear
